'''Derbits''' were small creatures that were kept as pets. While searching the destroyed remnants of a mining colony on [[Corbos]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyp Durron]] and [[Dorsk 82]] found a derbit case in an abandoned family unit, with the creature inside long dead.
